Crypto used to feel different.

Everything is AI now. AI-generated content, AI bots, AI agents… and sometimes it feels like we’re slowly losing something that made crypto special in the first place: the COMMUNITY.

Back in the early days, people actually talked. They shared ideas, discovered projects together, joked around, helped each other and stayed up all night discussing the next big thing.

It wasn’t just about charts, numbers or farming the next narrative.

It was about PEOPLE.

I think we should bring some of that energy back.

Let’s talk more.
Let’s interact more.
Let’s share things just because they’re interesting.
Let’s have fun again.

Crypto doesn’t have to be so serious all the time.

Let’s bring the community back 🫂
